design.design: ten-repeat event-disjoint two-fold cross-fit in both directions

fold_views.a_to_b: A-train diversity and B-test aggregation outcome
fold_views.b_to_a: B-train diversity and A-test aggregation outcome
fold_views.combined: ten A→B and ten B→A evaluations pooled

best_single.formula: higher test-fold adjusted Brier Index of base and partner on identical support
best_single.label: Best Single

cf_directional.formula: direction-specific clipped C / D weight fitted around the fixed base
cf_directional.label: Directional CF

piecewise_odds.formula: threshold-5 piecewise transform of the summed base/partner logits
piecewise_odds.label: Piecewise Odds

provenance.fixed_base_policy: the selected focal model is always the anchor; no train-fold model selection
provenance.pair_eligibility: reuse the released six-family cross-fit eligible pair universe
